Cc: HelioMed Accounts <accounts@heliomed.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Overdue retainer invoice — need VAT certificate and payment pause

Hi Jonas —

We received Invoice RDW-5243 (attached) but HelioMed has placed a temporary payment hold. Our tax team is requesting a copy of Redwood's EU VAT registration and a confirmation about reverse-charge treatment for this contract. Until we resolve the VAT treatment internally, AP is pausing the remittance.

I know this is late in the quarter for both of us; can you confirm whether Redwood will accept a short-term hold while we provide the VAT certificate? If not, please advise how you prefer we proceed — we can sign a short acknowledgment and make a partial payment.

Attachments: Invoice_RDW-5243_2027-07-01.pdf

Thanks,
Sofia Lopez
Head of Procurement
HelioMed Therapeutics
S: +44 20 7123 4456

Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Overdue retainer invoice — need VAT certificate and payment pause

Sofia — thanks for flagging and for the note. I understand tax teams need full documentation; we can provide the EU VAT registration (attaching) and a short statement on reverse charge treatment for services.

That said, this invoice is a 60-day retainer and currently 45 days overdue; Finance is seeing cash impact and has asked I propose an interim path. My proposal:
- We upload Redwood's VAT certificate to your AP mailbox (attached).
- HelioMed confirms receipt and acknowledges a 14-day payment pause while you get internal sign-off.
- If there is no confirmation within 14 days, Redwood will schedule a one-time exec touchpoint to discuss settlement options (see request below).

I'll copy Laura from Finance to document the ask and mark this for potential escalation to our Director of Revenue Ops if the hold extends beyond two weeks.

Attachments: HelioMed_VAT_certificate_2027.pdf

Best,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0199

Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 08:27:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Overdue retainer invoice — need VAT certificate and payment pause

Folks — adding Finance context.

Quick facts: invoice total = EUR 126,000 (net), VAT position depends on supplier registration and customer status (B2B reverse-charge likely but we need HelioMed's VAT id). If HelioMed is claiming reverse-charge they must provide the VAT number and an accounting memo.

Options we can accept today:
1) 14-day payment pause on receipt of VAT id + signed AP acknowledgment (no interest, conditional).
2) Partial release: 50% payment in 7 business days with the remainder on VAT confirmation. This reduces our cash risk and usually gets AR moving.
3) If neither happens within 14 days, escalate to collections and request an executive touchpoint to resolve outstanding balance or agree negotiated settlement (typically a small credit to close).

If you want my sign-off to accept option 2 (partial release), I can approve up to EUR 70,000 as an interim tranche, conditional on a Docusign acknowledgment from HelioMed and confirmation of VAT id to be posted to our secure drive.

Attachments: proposed-settlement-terms.xlsx

Laura Bennett
Senior Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Exec touchpoint request — HelioMed retainer hold (RDW-5243)

Evelyn / Markus —

Summary: HelioMed has put Invoice RDW-5243 on hold pending VAT confirmation. Finance has offered a partial release up to EUR 70,000 to reduce cash exposure (Laura attached the proposed terms). HelioMed has until 29 Aug to supply VAT id per their AP note; if they do not, Finance recommends we escalate to an executive call to resolve or approve a one-time concession (we are estimating a maximum goodwill credit of EUR 18,000 to close).

Why this needs your attention now:
- The retainer supports a recently ramped production deployment; ongoing usage could be impacted by enforcement of service restrictions.
- The account is strategic (enterprise with roadmap to expand three product modules next year).
- Legal has reviewed and confirmed we can accept a conditional partial payment while the VAT position is resolved, but exec approval required for any credit.

Ask: Can we schedule a 30-minute touchpoint early next week (Mon/Tue) to approve the contingency plan and sign off on the EUR 18,000 one-time concession if necessary? If approved, Laura will circulate the Docusign acknowledgement to HelioMed and we will queue the partial release.

Context links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/78910

Thanks,
Jonas
From: Sofia Lopez <s.lopez@heliomed.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Jonas / Laura —

Thanks for the quick coordination and for sending the VAT certificate. Our tax team has confirmed HelioMed's VAT id (HLMD-EU-33421) and they will apply reverse-charge; AP will process a 50% payment (EUR 63,000) this Friday once they receive the Docusign acknowledgement you mentioned. We will upload the VAT documentation to the shared folder and copy you.

We appreciate the flexibility — I can confirm no executive call required at this time as long as the partial payment plan proceeds and the remainder is cleared within 21 calendar days. I will send the signed acknowledgment via DocuSign (link below) today.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/REDACTED/HELIOMED-SETTLEMENT

Best,
